data.public_memory: Version v9 final review, teacher 5nn4_SC2_A_1017__top2. Budget is exhausted (5/5 rounds, 0 sampling rounds remaining), so all four selected arrays are archived, unexecuted suggestions. Pool minimum remains [7,5,4,4] 1.903213 Å; band edge 1.923213 Å. Round-5 anchors: G1 [5,8,5,5] 1.917782 Å/3.247845 pIC50/best 7.153755; G2 [5,7,6,6] 1.918301/3.247907/7.153836; G3 [5,7,4,4] 1.919211/3.247768/7.153836; G4 [5,6,4,3] 1.919874/3.247294/7.153825. All are in band. In-band mean gaps span roughly 3.2473-3.2479 pIC50, a sub-resolution tie; G4 is nominal in-band gap leader only. Response: interval0 is the sole high-capacity condition/function tradeoff. Lowering to 4 buys the concentrated tail and the only teacher-exceeding best (7.4558-7.4761) but leaves band by 0.0058-0.0079 Å; raising interval0 improves condition while worsening mean gap. Interval1 is not inert for the best channel at interval0=4 (+0.020350 for 5->8 in [4,8,5,5]) but its condition capacity, and the sum of intervals1-3 capacity, are an order of magnitude short of closing the branch deficit. Background: functional gain remains tail-driven and concentrated; best bonus is confined to the interval0=4 family; legal teacher subgraph mappings remain available for only 2-3 of 25 candidates, and all groups are 25/25 valid with zero failed attempts, so coordinates do not establish chemistry or affinity equivalence. Alternative: the best channel may require absolute interval0<=4 rather than interval1 ordering; if the in-band interval1 probes are null, retire the ordering rescue. Final allocation keeps G4:H1 as the only in-band measured-direction continuation, G4:H2 as its interval3-only decomposition, and G1:H1/G2:H1 as the remaining in-band best-transfer tests. Falsifiers: G4:H1 condition >1.923213 Å or no gap below 3.247294; G4:H2 flat while G4:H1 improves (interval1 carries the effect); G1:H1/G2:H1 best <=7.1539 (bonus confined to interval0<=4). Next action: archive these; do not spend further slots on interval3>=7, 1-tick refinements, or interval1-3 compensation.

data.population_diagnosis: Round-5 anchor [5,6,4,3] is inside the 0.02 Å band at mean condition 1.919874 Å against edge 1.923213 Å (margin 0.003339) and has the lowest in-band mean affinity gap 3.247294 pIC50. The in-band gap spread among interval0=5 schedules is only about 2-4e-4 pIC50, so this is a practical tie, not an above-noise functional lead. The interval0=4 family still carries gaps near 3.2093 and best affinities near 7.4558-7.4761, but remains outside band by about 0.0058-0.0079 Å; measured non-interval0 compensation is ~1e-3 Å and cannot rescue it. The immediately preceding change from [5,8,4,5] to [5,6,4,3] lowered interval1 and interval3 by 2 ticks each and moved condition +0.001972 Å while improving gap by 0.000542 pIC50, so the anchor sits on a small, tail-driven continuation direction rather than a resolved mechanism.
data.memory_update: Keep interval0=5 as the band-safe operating regime and treat [5,6,4,3] as the current in-band leader/tie reference. Final archived proposals should continue the observed interval1/3 lowering direction and isolate its interval3 component: [5,4,4,1] and [5,6,4,1]. Do not spend final-version logic on interval0=4 compensation, interval3>=7, 1-tick refinements, or chemistry/affinity equivalence claims from coordinates. Any apparent mean-gap gain must be read with its high-score tail member and with top10/best stability; best bonus remains confined to interval0=4 and is not expected in band.
